label: Synthetic surveillance teaching prototype · public geography, population and climate

privacy.rounding: Counts are rounded down to multiples of five. Positive counts below five are withheld.
privacy.policy: Only disjoint district/disease/week observations are released. No admissions, deaths, daily case counts or exact parent totals are published. Arithmetic logistics families are suppressed together. Displayed sums include only visible cells.
privacy.limitations: Small-cell and complementary-total controls; not a differential-privacy guarantee.
